name: Social Detachment
description: Pattern related to social withdrawal, feeling disconnected, or reluctance to engage with others.
safetyGuidance: This is not a clinical diagnosis. Pattern match based on reported social isolation or detachment.

solutions.title: Mindfulness Meditation
solutions.purpose: Help user observe thoughts and connect gently with internal feelings.
instructions: Sit comfortably and notice the physical presence of your body.
Acknowledge feelings of isolation without self-criticism.
Breathe warmly into your chest area.

solutions.title: Self-Reflection
solutions.purpose: Give the user structured prompts to reflect on their current emotional state.
instructions: Reflect on one person who has been supportive or safe in the past.
Consider what kind of low-pressure connection feels manageable today.
Acknowledge that small social steps are completely valid.

solutions.title: Small Social Step
solutions.purpose: Encourage one small manageable social action.

solutions.title: Guided Breathing
solutions.purpose: Provide a short calming breathing activity.
instructions: Settle your nervous system into ease.

solutions.title: Confidence-Building Activity
solutions.purpose: Give the user one small achievable action that can build confidence in social interaction.
